items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1959-10-03
items.q: I used to play with him. ... We used to go all around, you know, and all around the French market and all down on Decatur Street ... We used to go around and play, you know.

ctx.x: Well, I used to fool around a musician, they taught me a few things. Fester Monette crossed the river. And I used to be with one of the best guitar players in town, they called him Frank Wagner. He hung himself. He was working on the P.W.A., things got rough around there and he couldn't support his mother like he wanted, so he just tied a rope around his neck.
